verdict.rationale: Codebase understanding is a fair question for a desktop coding-agent app, so the axis applies. The evidence only says the app works with a coding agent on your projects and handles git and PR operations. Nothing documents the agent autonomously exploring, indexing, mapping or explaining an unfamiliar codebase without manual context selection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files
